title: Ice Cream Oreo Cookie Pie
description: Made with mini Oreo cookies, this simple ice cream cookie pie is embarrassingly easy to put together and will be popular with party guests of all ages.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package mini chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo® Mini)
1 (6 ounce) chocolate sandwich cookie crumb crust (such as an OREO® crust)
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Reserve 8 mini sandwich cookies for garnish. Place remaining cookies in a food processor or plastic bag and crush coarsely.
Stir crushed cookies into softened ice cream. Spread ice cream mixture into cookie crust and place in the freezer until set, about 1 hour.
Pipe whipped topping around the edge of pie and top with reserved cookies, standing on ends. Freeze before serving, 3 to 8 hours.
